title: Provimux Savings: the totals of one day
description: The value of KV key provimux:savings:v1:day:<YYYY-MM-DD>: absolute totals of one calendar day of the server's time zone. Written whole by one goroutine; never incremented in place. Readers ignore properties they do not know, so a later version can add counters without a migration.

tz.description: The server's zone when the day was first written (time.Local's name).

utc_offset.description: That zone's offset in seconds at that moment.

folded.description: True once the day reached the row limit and rows were folded into model and key ~other.

keys.description: Client key id -> the key's last 4 characters, or "" for a key under 16 characters. Never a key.

prices.description: Price id -> the price this day is valued at: the first one seen for that id on this day, never changed afterwards.

rows.description: At most 2000 rows, plus one row with model and key ~other per kind, provider and host once the limit was reached.

cr.description: Cache read. Absent when the source publishes none.

cw.description: Cache write. Absent when the source publishes none.

cw1h.description: 1 hour cache write. Absent when the source publishes none.

row.description: One combination of account kind, provider, host, model and client key. The five together are unique in a day.

k.description: Account kind: oauth, apikey or unknown.

h.description: Host of an API key's base URL, lower case. Absent for none.

m.description: Model id, lower case; ~other for folded rows.

c.description: Client key id; absent for a request without a client key; ~other for folded rows.

pm.description: Price id in this day's prices, set the first time the row is written while a price is known. Absent while none is.

pmm.description: How m was matched to pm: exact, variant, normalized or table.

counters.description: Sums over the row's usage records. A counter that is 0 is left out.

cw5.description: The part of cw reported as 5 minute writes.

cw1h.description: The part of cw reported as 1 hour writes.

cost.description: cost_details.cost, in billionths of a US dollar.

ucost.description: cost_details.upstream_inference_cost of bring-your-own-key records, in billionths of a US dollar.
